subject.title: feat(skills): capture reusable techniques from successful work

question: Should successful-work technique capture become part of the existing opt-in Skill Workshop autonomy behavior after the cross-mode prompt defect is fixed?
rationale: The change preserves pending review and adds neither configuration nor a second model call, but asking the active agent to infer reusable techniques expands its autonomy and false-positive surface.

options.title: Adopt conservative capture
options.body: Fix prompt parity, retain strict abstention and credential checks, and land successful-work capture under the existing opt-in setting.

options.title: Keep explicit signals only
options.body: Retain capture only for explicit user instructions and corrections, without inferring techniques from successful work.

recommendation.title: Adopt conservative capture
recommendation.body: Fix prompt parity, retain strict abstention and credential checks, and land successful-work capture under the existing opt-in setting.
